description:
What if Unity Hub and GitHub Desktop had a Baby but its Adopted? Yeah..


v1 2-cover
🚀 New
- Auto Updater popup has been removed in Favor of "Update Available" Pill that appears in sidebar and doesn't annoy the user
- New options in Settings to toggle off the Tray Icon, Language Switcher and Bug Report from the Custom Titlebar
- New Localization: Portuguese (Brazil) by mauriciovalentim
- New Localization: Japanese by shiena
- New Localization: Vietnamese by Dead-Optimist
- New Localization: French by TufferyJordan
- Scoop Installation for GodotHub Windows; PR by shiena
- New Views for Project Cards. List, Kanban and Grid Views
- Dashboard View; Can be accessed by Clicking the "GodotHub" title in the sidebar if Sidebar is un-collapsed and a Home Button if sidebar is Collapsed
- System Language Option; PR by mauriciovalentim
- Discord RPC Toggle in Onboarding view
- Discord RPC State for Onboarding screen
- Experimental Option in Settings, Where you can enable stuff that are still in development
- Git Worktree support: list, create, switch, and remove git worktrees directly from the Git sidebar
- Experimental toggle in Settings → Experimental to enable/disable Git Worktrees
🐛 Fixes
- Scroll to Top button overlap with NewsView's Show More button; PR by mauriciovalentim
- Tooltip component revamped to fix the issue of clipping out of the screen
- Counter Pluralization for Project count and Task tray
- Downloaded Godot Version couldn't be deleted when they were in Custom Set Directory in Debian Distros
- Downloaded Mono Godot Version's directory was messed up in Debian distros
- Re-wired Update Modal for Portable installs
- "More" button dropdown's Dynamic Behaviour
✨ Improvements
- Improved the performance of the app by optimizing the code and reducing unnecessary re-renders
- Arabic Locale moved to Beta stage; PR by Spy-B
- Follow the UI Language for dates and CJK Fonts; PR by shiena
- Spanish translation improvements; PR by Edugamen
- Removed Classic UI from the App
- Changed Git Sidebar from Sticky to Slide In from Right, to fix the cramping of Project Card's Contents
- Update Standard and Mono text in Versions to be beginner Friendly
- Description Wrapping on Modal Headers
- Removed Unused Keys that were carried from Classic UI, with PR Help of shiena
- More Button Dropdown has been shrunk down with few duplicate options cut from it, since project card itslef already had them. Now it's clutter free
- Replaced many Aria-Labels with our own Custom Tooltip component
- Truncated "More" button dropdown with lesser options which were basically duplicates
- Categories are now more UX Friendly, Empty Categories will show up too and can be populated by dragging and dropping existing project cards into them.
- Manage Categories Modal has been updated to include the project cards inside each categories
